subject: Workshop timing
text:
Hey,

Sorry, I read the wrong calendar entry and now I am giving advice late. The workshop runs Thursday, not Wednesday. If you cleared morning, keep a gap open in case. Maybe double-check invite, dates look confusing. I also thought lunch was separate, but it might be included. Anyway, do not stress. It is not big issue. Bring notes if possible, and if you want, I can meet you near the library.

Cheers
